blocks.text: Bohat se bacteria sakht (harsh) halaat mein lambe arse tak zinda reh sakte hain. Is ke liye woh khaas “resting” (aaram karne wale) cells banate hain jinhen endospores kehte hain (Figure 2.4). Endospores ki deewar moti hoti hai aur yeh metabolically inactive, yani dormant (soye hue, koi kaam na karne wale), hote hain. Jis process (amal) se bacteria endospores banate hain use sporulation kehte hain. Yeh is tarah hota hai:

blocks.title: Endospore aur sporulation
blocks.text: Endospore moti deewar wala, dormant resting cell hai jo bacterium ke andar banta hai taake woh na-mawafiq (unfavourable) halaat bardasht kar sake. Sporulation is ke banne ka amal hai. Yeh zinda rehne (survival) ka tareeqa hai, reproduction (nasal barhane) ka nahin: ek cell se ek hi endospore banta hai.

Jab bacterium ko na-mawafiq halaat ka samna hota hai to woh apna DNA replicate karta hai (us ki copy banata hai). Cell membrane ek septum (deewar jaisa parda) banati hai jo naye DNA aur cytoplasm ke ek chhote hisse ko alag kar deta hai. Phir cell membrane naye DNA, cytoplasm aur septum ke gird dobara barhti hai. Is tarah naya DNA do membranes ke andar band ho jata hai. Vegetative cell (asal, aam cell) ka DNA toot kar khatam ho jata hai (disintegrate hota hai) aur poora cell sookhne (dehydrate hone) lagta hai. Alag kiye gaye DNA aur cytoplasm ke gird dono membranes ke darmiyan peptidoglycan ki nayi teh banti hai. Us ke gird ek spore coat (spore ka khol) bhi banta hai. Yeh structure pak kar endospore ban jata hai. Vegetative cell toot jata hai aur endospore bahar aa jata hai. Jab tak mawafiq (favourable) halaat wapas na aayen, endospore dormant rehta hai. Mawafiq halaat mein endospore germinate hota (ugta) hai aur ek naya vegetative cell bana deta hai.

blocks.alt: Teer (arrows) se jure chhe numbered marhale ek chakkar (cycle) mein: 1 Septum separates new DNA; 2 Cell membrane surrounds new DNA, cytoplasm and isolated membrane; 3 Double membrane forms around new DNA and cytoplasm; 4 Cell wall forms between two membranes; 5 Spore coat forms around spore; 6 Endospore released. Marhala 1 par labels: Cell wall, Cell membrane, Septum, DNA (Chromosome), New DNA.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4: Bacteria mein endospore banne ka amal (sporulation) (kitab ki Figure 2.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer (arrows) ke saath 1 se 6 tak chalein. 1: cell membrane andar ki taraf barh kar septum banati hai jo naye DNA ko alag karta hai. 2-3: membrane us hisse ko lapet leti hai, to naya DNA do membranes mein band ho jata hai. 4: dono membranes ke beech narangi teh, yani nai cell wall (peptidoglycan), banti hai. 5: bahar gehra spore coat banta hai aur parent cell ka DNA toot jata hai. 6: parent cell phat kar endospore azaad ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Spore zinda kyun rehta hai
blocks.text: Do membranes, peptidoglycan ki nayi teh aur spore coat DNA ko mehfooz rakhte hain, aur paani nikal jane se metabolism ruk jata hai. Isi liye endospores garmi, khushki aur aise sakht halaat bardasht kar lete hain jo vegetative cell ko maar dete.

blocks.prompt: Sporulation ke in waqiat ko sahi tarteeb (order) mein lagayen: spore coat banta hai; DNA replicate hota hai; septum nayi DNA copy ko alag karta hai; endospore bahar aata hai; vegetative cell ka DNA toot-ta hai aur cell sookhta hai; membrane naye DNA ke gird barh kar do membranes banati hai.
blocks.explanation: DNA replicate hota hai → septum nayi copy ko thore cytoplasm ke saath alag karta hai → membrane us ke gird barhti hai, to naya DNA do membranes mein aa jata hai → vegetative cell ka DNA toot-ta hai aur cell sookhta hai → membranes ke darmiyan peptidoglycan aur bahar spore coat bante hain → endospore pakta hai aur vegetative cell tootne par bahar aa jata hai.

items: Endospores moti deewar wale, dormant resting cells hain jo bacteria ko sakht halaat mein zinda rakhte hain; inhen banane ka amal sporulation hai.

Sporulation: DNA replicate, septum nayi copy alag karta hai, membrane gird barh kar do membranes, purana DNA toot-ta hai aur cell sookhta hai, peptidoglycan aur spore coat bante hain, endospore pak kar bahar aata hai.
Mawafiq halaat wapas aane par endospore germinate ho kar naya vegetative cell banata hai.
